promptZh: What did travelling performers do in the past? 根据短文内容，选择最佳答案。

explanation.summaryZh: 过去流动艺人在天黑后于乡村广场支起白布幕，在幕后操纵皮影演唱故事。
explanation.ruleZh: 细节题：根据题干关键词回到原文定位对应句，对比选项即可确定答案。

evidence.quote: travelling performers set up a white cloth screen in village squares after dark

options.text: They carved stone statues in villages.
They performed shadow plays on white cloth screens at night.
They taught villagers to make leather.
